values.goal: Produce one independent findings-first review of the complete v0.92.2 planning package at an immutable revision.
values.required_outcome: One exact-revision planning review report with a complete review denominator and evidence-backed disposition for every finding.
authority_boundary: The review is read-only against one immutable planning revision
Findings do not authorize remediation inside this issue
The review does not approve the current release or create successor issues
operator_constraints: Do not edit reviewed planning files
Do not begin until #524 has a reviewed merge
Do not convert green validators into semantic approval
